## Update: Pin/Unpin Projects added

In addition to the dynamic sorting, I've now added the ability to **pin projects** to the top of the sidebar:

- **Right-click → "Pin to top"** keeps a project permanently at the top
- **Right-click → "Unpin"** releases it
- Dynamic sorting never moves projects above pinned ones — pinned projects always stay on top
- i18n for all 15 languages included

This covers the use case where you have a few projects you work on daily and want them always at the top, while still benefiting from dynamic sorting for everything else.

## :robot: Codex Code Review

**PR: feat: add text-to-speech for agent responses**

This PR adds text-to-speech functionality for assistant responses, implementing both a browser-based solution using the Web Speech API and a server-side solution using Microsoft Edge TTS (node-edge-tts).

---

### Issues and Recommendations

#### 1. Memory Leak in TTSProvider (packages/app/src/context/tts.tsx)

**File:** `packages/app/src/context/tts.tsx`
**Lines:** 14-15

```typescript
const spokenParts = new Set<string>()
```

The `spokenParts` Set is created outside of any cleanup mechanism and will grow indefinitely as the user interacts with the application. Over long sessions, this could cause memory issues.

**Recommendation:** Implement a cleanup strategy, such as:
- Using a WeakMap if possible
- Limiting the Set size with LRU-style eviction
- Clearing on session change

---

#### 2. Inconsistent Default Voice (packages/opencode/src/tts/index.ts)

**File:** `packages/opencode/src/tts/index.ts`

The ConfigSchema defaults to `"en-US-AvaNeural"` but `processQueue()` uses `"en-US-AriaNeural"` as the fallback:

```typescript
// Line 50 in ConfigSchema
voice: Voice.optional().default("en-US-AvaNeural")

// Line 250 in processQueue
voice: ttsConfig?.voice ?? "en-US-AriaNeural"
```

**Recommendation:** Use a single constant for the default voice to ensure consistency.

---

#### 3. Missing Error Handling for Event Listener (packages/app/src/context/tts.tsx)

**File:** `packages/app/src/context/tts.tsx`
**Lines:** 18-36

The event listener setup has try-catch blocks but silently swallows errors. While this prevents crashes, it makes debugging difficult when TTS fails to work.

**Recommendation:** Add logging or a development-mode warning when errors occur:

```typescript
} catch (error) {
  if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development') {
    console.warn('TTS event handler error:', error)
  }
}
```

---

#### 4. Potential Command Injection (packages/opencode/src/tts/index.ts)

**File:** `packages/opencode/src/tts/index.ts`
**Lines:** 298-303

The Windows PowerShell command embeds the filepath directly in a string:

```typescript
command = [
  "powershell",
  "-Command",
  `Add-Type -AssemblyName presentationCore; ... $player.Open('${filepath}'); ...`
]
```

While the filepath is generated internally, if the temp directory path contains special characters or single quotes, this could cause issues or injection vulnerabilities.

**Recommendation:** Use `-File` parameter or properly escape the path:

```typescript
const escapedPath = filepath.replace(/'/g, "''")
```

---

#### 5. Race Condition in Audio Queue (packages/opencode/src/tts/index.ts)

**File:** `packages/opencode/src/tts/index.ts`
**Lines:** 218-225

```typescript
async function processQueue() {
  if (speaking || audioQueue.length === 0) return
  speaking = true
  const item = audioQueue.shift()!
```

There is a potential race condition if `processQueue()` is called concurrently before `speaking = true` is set. This could cause two items to be processed simultaneously.

**Recommendation:** Use a mutex or atomic flag pattern to ensure thread-safety.

---

#### 6. Hardcoded Styles (packages/app/src/components/tts-control-bar.tsx)

**File:** `packages/app/src/components/tts-control-bar.tsx`
**Lines:** 127-128, 142-143, 157-158

The select elements have hardcoded inline styles:

```typescript
style={{ "background-color": "#1a1a1a", color: "#e0e0e0" }}
```

**Recommendation:** Use CSS variables or Tailwind classes to respect the application's theme system and support light/dark mode properly.

---

#### 7. Missing Cleanup for spokenParts Set (packages/app/src/context/tts.tsx)

**File:** `packages/app/src/context/tts.tsx`
**Lines:** 14-15

The `spokenParts` Set never gets cleared, even when navigating to a new session.

**Recommendation:** Add cleanup logic when session changes or implement a maximum size limit.

---

#### 8. No Type Safety for Event Payload (packages/app/src/context/tts.tsx)

## Update: Improved settings label wording

Based on feedback from @stenci, updated the settings description to be shorter and provider-agnostic:

- **Before:** "Automatically move active projects and sessions to the top when Claude starts working on them"
- **After:** "Move recently active projects to the top"

Also fixed all i18n translations — title and description were previously left as English in 13 languages, now properly translated for all 15 supported languages.
